items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: we were given a chance by Mr. Jacques Canetti, to record for Brunswick.

ctx.x: As I explained, we -- the band was just an augmentation of -- we just augmented Bricktop's band, that we had at Bricktop's, and we were given a chance by Mr. Jacques Canetti, to record for Brunswick.
So, as we -- we would have -- I told you that the form that I gave you, the formation -- did we mention names, at all?
